name: OpenMercantil
description: Independent public-data API for Spanish company search, BORME registry-event timelines, source traceability and public-source business context.
notes: OpenMercantil helps developers, SMEs, analysts, journalists, researchers and citizens reuse Spanish public mercantile data through search, BORME event timelines, downloads and a documented OpenAPI file. It is an independent informational project, not an official registry API or a substitute for certified registry documents.
